items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The comment "# 1 table is involved if the query only has a single alias." does not explain the non-obvious `get_initial_alias()` call, which is the actual fix. The new test also leaves two blank lines inside the class body (PEP8/flake8 E303).

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Small change that reuses existing helpers (`get_initial_alias`, `count_active_tables`). The `all(refcount == 0)` guard is redundant because `get_initial_alias` is already idempotent, but it is harmless. No dead code; the scratch file was removed.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: No exception handling is needed. Registering the base alias via the existing API is safe and idempotent, and no magic constants are added beyond the inherent `== 1`.

items.name: Subquery dropped only for genuine single-table deletes
items.name_zh: 仅在真正单表删除时去掉子查询
items.evidence: Fixes the root cause in `single_alias`: the base alias is registered before tables are counted, so joined deletes still produce `pk__in` subqueries (verified in the scratch output). The MySQL compiler benefits too, with no backend special-casing. Hidden tests: F2P 1/1, P2P 52/52.
